behavior.classification: Only terminal independent IK records are scanned for table_collision/interarm_collision prefixes or collision pairs. Raw status/evidence retained with source paths. RRT attempts/last_answer, branch-wrapper answer, timeout and inactive recovery history do not leak pairs into INVALID.
behavior.escalation: Non-collision UNKNOWN has at most one escalation per action key from its original seed limit to 24. It retries the exact rolled-back action/state/snapshot without resetting its validated prefix. Already-24 UNKNOWN does not trigger another duplicate upgrade.
behavior.seed_bank: deterministic_ik_seeds(cfg,count) retains original unique seeds and adds deterministic six-dimensional Halton entries. At least count unique bank rows ensure compiler current-q insertion/dedup still produces count distinct trials. Helper supports 24 and 32 without mutating cfg.
behavior.cache: Backend-local _SeedCompiler uses shared per-action seed overrides. Temporary cfg view includes bank SHA in geometry_version and limits contains 24; main/scratch/final compilation retains original runner compiler identity and exact certificates. Other action contexts stay at the original seed limit.
behavior.cuts: Both INVALID and post-escalation UNKNOWN receive state/action cuts, counted only once per distinct cut. Three cuts for one action key invalidate corresponding run-local reach facts, with explicit motion-level avoidance source. liftable is untouched; support_off maps to its arm/slot.
behavior.oracle: Working Problem is shallow-copied with a deep oracle copy. Honest qualification updates both working and caller oracle for compatibility; motion-driven reach downgrades affect only the working oracle exposed in PipelineResult.
behavior.round_limit: Real backend default 12, other backends default 6, explicit max_rounds preserved. Round exhaustion is budget. Search no_plan under uncertain motion cuts is overall unknown; conditional search status remains no_plan. Remote fatal loss stops upgrades and further search.
behavior.evidence: plan.feedback contains action/round/reason/cut/downgrade messages; backend.audit.feedback_rounds stores structured per-round search and motion attempts. Existing runner motion_feedback_count still counts INVALID validations only and must not be used as all-cut count.
